notes: AWLS-SDST stage 2: improve quality after stage-1 setup-aware timing made schedules legal.
Only awls_sdst_move_evaluation is user-confirmed in this manifest. The worker may change NK/change-machine move scoring only.
The worker must reuse harness_agent.standard_fjsp.setup_time_between; it must not create a parser, evaluator, or setup helper file.

slots.title: AWLS-SDST setup-aware change-machine move scoring
slots.purpose: Rank AWLS change-machine NK moves with setup-aware cost information so local search does not select moves that look good in processing-time space but increase sequence-dependent setup makespan.
inputs: where: target operation node on the destination machine
intersection_first/intersection_last: RK/LK window boundaries from change_machine_window
outputs: A numeric move score where smaller is preferred by find_move.
The score must remain compatible with cpp_int_score when zi_policy is cpp/cpp-exact.
No mutation of schedule or global state.
invariants: Keep standard FJSP behavior close to the current score when instance.has_sequence_dependent_setup is false.
If the slot calls setup_time_between, import it locally inside the slot; do not assume a module-level import exists.
Move method values are string constants CHANGE_MACHINE_FRONT and CHANGE_MACHINE_BACK, not integers.
Never call setup_time_between with current_op=None; first/last machine positions have zero missing-edge setup.
For SDST, account for setup cost around the removed source position and inserted target position, or use a bounded exact clone/apply evaluation if that stays inside the slot.
Do not modify move generation, legality filters, parser, evaluator, solution schema, CLI arguments, or benchmark semantics.
Do not change same-machine N7 scoring in this stage unless a separate slot is confirmed.
allowed_edits: Only rewrite code between awls_sdst_move_evaluation markers.
May add local helper functions or lambdas inside the slot.
May import setup_time_between locally inside the slot.
May call setup_time_between(instance, machine_id, previous_op, current_op, schedule.index).
May map AWLS node ids to operation keys using schedule.index.node_to_job and schedule.index.node_to_op.
May clone the schedule and apply Move(method, which, where) to get exact setup-aware makespan for this candidate, if errors are handled locally.
For exact scoring, use trial.makespan after apply_move; do not read trial.end_time[trial.index.end_node].
May return a tuple-like weighted score encoded as one float, but smaller must remain better and cpp_int_score compatibility must be preserved.
forbidden_edits: Do not create helper files for setup parsing or move evaluation.
Do not change AwlsSchedule.update_time in this stage.
Do not change same_machine_evaluate_stable or same_machine_evaluate_cpp_fast in this stage.
Do not change zi policy in this stage.
Do not touch harness_agent.standard_fjsp or examples/standard_fjsp_evaluator.py.
